name: Anna
source: The commander of the Far-East branch of "Innocence" also known as "Frozen Anna". A beauty with exquisite silver hair and a bombshell figure. She's usually emotionless, does not hesitate to use any and all available means to complete her mission and issues orders coldly and ruthlessly. She's skilled at stimulating the acupressure points of her targets.
